shapes.name: title
shapes.text: Purpose: sustained research that improves AI4Research

shapes.name: subtitle
shapes.text: Independent labs produce reports and discoveries, retain knowledge and develop reusable capabilities

shapes.name: source
shapes.text: Intended project value, not a measured gain. Karpathy quote: Dwarkesh Podcast, October 17, 2025.

shapes.name: goal
shapes.text:
Give teams a durable environment for
research that can learn and change course

shapes.name: investigate
shapes.text:
Investigate and experiment
with a lab’s own AI4R

shapes.name: retain
shapes.text:
Retain reports, findings
and supporting evidence

shapes.name: contribute
shapes.text:
Discoveries and reports
Reusable CC improvements

shapes.name: value bottom
shapes.text: Expected value: less restart work, reusable capabilities, independent experimentation and better use of limited compute.

shapes.name: quote
shapes.text:
“You can’t just tell them something
and they’ll remember it.”

shapes.name: quote attribution
shapes.text: Andrej Karpathy, October 17, 2025

shapes.name: takeaway text
shapes.text: Persistent lab state supports continuity. It does not solve continual learning in model weights.

shapes.name: source
shapes.text: Private execution is a design profile. GPU / device support and available compute require host-specific qualification.

shapes.name: title
shapes.text: Persistent data survives experiment and runtime replacement

shapes.name: subtitle
shapes.text: Stopping compute preserves the project. Restart verifies state before continuing the research cycle.

shapes.name: source
shapes.text: Designed lifecycle. Actual termination, external power-off, backup and restore remain acceptance tests.

shapes.name: title

shapes.name: subtitle
shapes.text: Reuse compatible components and keep AI4R’s research and qualification decisions under our control

shapes.name: source
